snippet.title: STAR WARS: Galactic Racer™ Official Release Date Reveal - Pre-Order Announcement
snippet.description:
STAR WARS: Galactic Racer™ launches worldwide on October 6th. Pre-order today for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC.

Pre-order the Standard, Deluxe, or Collector's Edition today to receive two exclusive bonuses: an additional Livery for your repulsorcraft and a special Player Banner for multiplayer modes.

Visit the official website to pre-order now:

Official Site - https://starwarsgalacticracer.com/

Follow for updates on social media:

Discord - https://discord.gg/starwarsgalacticracer
Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/starwarsgalacticracer/ 
X - https://x.com/SWGalacticRacer
TikTok - https://www.tiktok.com/@starwarsgalacticracer
Facebook - https://www.facebook.com/SWGalacticRacer
